# unsaved-warning

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./singularity build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Warns once per page load, with an error toast, when the browser refuses to save a draft (storage full or blocked) — the text then lives only in memory and a reload loses it.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `DraftSlots.Root` → `UnsavedDraftWarning`
  - Uses:
    - `primitives/persistent-draft.DraftSlots`
    - `primitives/persistent-draft.onDraftWriteFailed`
    - `shell/toast.showToast`
